notes.title: Patch 0.1.7
notes.content:
- Remappable bindings
- French localization
- Support for mouse and stick sensitivity
- Ultrawide support for more UIs
- First level octopus AnimBP fixes + anim update
- Achievement bounding volume adjustement
- Adjusted octopus trigger box first level
- Stamina UI updated color and visibility
- Restart UI update/bounding box adjust
- Fixed a bunch of overlapping events that could get triggered by any actors
- Checkpoints UI
- Prevent user from closing the rock UI and critter UI in the first second so as to not close it by mistake
- Direction trail stops when reach goal
- Rocks placement update
- Tutorials UIs only appear once now
- Fixed “press spacebar to get up” appearing when falling in the void
- Start text audio
- Worked on the audio for the Octopus level
- Warning to lower settings when at low FPS
- Escape key/Gamepad B close menus
- Fixed bug when opening UI at the same time as collecting a rock, the UI wouldn’t receive mouse input
- Audio levels settings
- Fixed bug in state machine when jumping from climbing and starting to climb while in air
- Pausing game when controller is disconnected
- Fixed pause menu access in loading screen
- Screen shake setting
- Fixed audio spatialization problem with ambient sounds
- Level transition ragdoll fix
- Escape key supported on all UIs
- Settings now in start menu
- 1 sec delay before being able to close some UI to avoid closing them by mistake
- Respawn rocks longer to respawn
- Fixed bug where climbing would be deactivated
- Fixed octopus staying in bind pose bug first level
- Fixed first level’s tree2 camera flicker bug
- Improved camera

notes.title: Patch 0.1.6
notes.content:
- Restart to last checkpoint explanation
- DirectionTrail + explanation
- Adjusted the quantity of rocks
- Octopus level reduced audio radius around octopus
- Now giving parachute in octopus level
- Changed reward of capybaras in octopus level
- Rocks explanation
- Jump from climbing is now more responsive and also fixed a bug where if you let go near the moment you jump it would double launch the character. Fixed the landing anim too.
- Catching critters explanation
- Reworked beginning text a tiny bit
- Fixed critter UI staying on top of quit UI
- Added an achievement in the first level
- Fixed a bug where the game launching would also try to launch SteamVR
- Respawn instruction now at the beginning
- Can now control the character when in ragdoll
- Brought back an area that was chopped off in the first level
- Camera behaves better when at grass level
- Gliding stamina UI disappears right away when full
- UI Texts a bit bigger for better visibility
- Full screen mode settings
- Different screen resolution support

notes.title: Patch 0.1.5
notes.content:
- Fixed the octopus freezing bug
- Clarified the stream/youtube temporary restriction
- Put bird in first level to help a bit with the direction
- Clarified respawn instruction
- Bell sound
- Beginning text update

notes.title: Patch 0.1.4
notes.content:
- Optimized build size (this update will be large for people who already downloaded the game, but smaller for new people going forward)
- Clarified how to get up when going ragdoll (centered subtitle with longer exposure)

notes.title: Patch 0.0.7
notes.content:
- Much faster death respawn at checkpoints
- Faster deaths in air: if there is nothing below the player will die instead of slowly falling all the way down the level
- First Level now with octopus + audio
- Updated first tree main branch cannot jump from it to the platform now
- More responsive controls: can now jump as soon as landed
- More responsive controls: can jump in air for a tiny window of time when falling
- New control update introduced minor visual bugs with state machine, will fix in upcoming builds

notes.title: Patch 0.0.6
notes.content:
- First level, added checkpoints to make it easier
- Starting to address the awkward slopes problem. Splash and Cave levels have the new fix (darker unwalkable slopes).
- Controller shake now with gliding stamina
- Stamina widgets now in the center of the screen and color coded
- First level mushrooms collision with camera off for now
- Orienting camera when spawning at checkpoints
- New audio atmosphere for octopus level
- Snake difficulty is now more progressive, also fixed stamina widget flicker when walking

notes.title: Patch 0.0.5
notes.content:
- Added more checkpoints at the end of the first level to make it easier
- New cave audio for the atmosphere
- New audio for the splash level atmosphere
- Added new audio at the beginning and end of the start level
- Added sound effects to the mangrove
- Mangrove level audio: geyser, droginhas and thunder at the end
- The "ears" of the audio is now at the player location instead of camera
- Fixed game analytics input device detection (gamepad or keyboard)
- Reduced mangrove max anim speed
- Updated first tree and instructions to make it easier

notes.title: Patch 0.0.4
notes.content:
- Start level added more rocks to make it easier checkpoint 5
- When stuck on ragdoll on the snake, now pushing the ragdoll out
- Added an explanation on how to get up from falling from first ragdoll
- Removed bottom watermark
- Removed hit sound when getting hit by climbable mesh
- Octopus level, the new checkpoint from last update now has a trigger to set octopus state

notes.title: Patch 0.0.3
notes.content:
- Updated level order to prioritize level/creatures for this playtest
- Gliding stamina explanation
- Lowered difficulty for the mangroves
- Added floating rock at start level's checkpoint5_1 to make it a bit easier for now
- New gliding stamina widget
- New audio for the mangrove level
- Added some on-screen explanation for rotating camera at the bubble path
- First level reworked first tree to make things a bit clearer
- Stamina gauge now working well with snake
- Worked a bit on level transition
- Temporarily made octopus level easier with floating rocks

notes.title: Patch 0.0.2
notes.content:
- Reworked the beginning of the game to make it easier and more obvious what to do / where to go
- On screen explanation at the beginning for core mechanics
- Added a "bubble path" to connect the first island to the rest of the level
- Fixed freeze at splash level's end
- FPS now capping at 120
- Updated watermark
- Fixed bug where when transitioning from level 1 to 2 the character would get stuck in ragdoll
- In first level, fixed tree 2 collisions
- Separating game in multiple pak files to help make patching faster
